fusions.name: Drover's Goad
fusions.desc: Jabs the target with a goad for 13 damage, drives it back 3.5 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Ring of Horns
fusions.desc: Horn-points turn outward all around you, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Prod the Herd On
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Slow to Rile
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
